headline: New Update!  - version 1.1.10
openingRemarks: New Item Window and Improved Security

newFeatures.title: Item Window
newFeatures.description: Now when you click on items or item links, a window will pop up with more details about the item. You can see this in the Campaign, Profile, & Iventory pages, as well as the Awaiting Battle & Battle Report windows.

newFeatures.title: Improved UI for User Profiles
newFeatures.description: Various UI improvements and all earned costumes are now showing up in profile

bugFixes: The server errors people experienced over the last week were related to implementation of improved security measures, and should be resolved
After Spending all your QP, the 'Quantum Points Activated' message will go away
Resolved error where sometimes users couldn't Go To Battle when they should have been able to
balanceChanges: Reduced difficulty of foes slightly across the board
Reduced XP gained for battles in general
miscDetails: The Hero Name input on the Select Hero page will now check to see if the name is available as they type. This was added to prevent naming collisions and improve new user's experience
Security has been improved across the application
Major code refactoring related to http requests both on the client side and server side has been completed
closingRemarks: More code refactoring ahead, but there's more new content in the works too ;)
